custody: Exact independently authenticated root/issuer selection and source/package/input identities. Original reference/context/journal/store closure consumed; whole original usage projections independently checked.
meaning: Declared protocol-label recovery under documented whole available-support controls. No causal/native-neural-understanding/population-validity or SOTA claim.
original_attempt: Exact consumed invocation claim and completed preparation file pins plus original directory identity are authenticated in terminal custody and joined by original run contract, observer and grader. Any retained failure/partial-failure record prevents terminal admission.
pre_store_failure: Private attempt records retain exact stage, original structured failure receipt/cause, metadata/native/canonical/preparation counters, partial writes and cleanup outcomes within selected bounds. Capture failures retain bounded fallback records or explicit stderr pointer/counter/error metadata; missing durability never becomes success.
scoring: Equal record mean per person/protocol, equal available protocols per person, equal13people. Same weights for Brier. Failure rows remain with accuracy0/Brier2; missing required inputs or infrastructure evidence invalidates qualification.
source_only: Initial source package is unconfigured and not scientifically qualified. Engineering controls are not full-run results.
status: complete_with_candidate_failures includes any explicit context failure or any None prediction; incorrect valid predictions alone do not change completion status
